text_block_list.text:
One evening. After finishing some 
necessary errands, I was walking through 
the shopping district when—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Trainer-san, there's a huge crowd 
gathering. Maybe there's a sale on protein 
powder?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, sporty miss over there! Care to give 
it a try~?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
A lottery...! Come to think of it, 
Trainer, we got an auxiliary ticket 
earlier, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"One of the main tickets! Or five of the 
bonus tickets! If you combine everything 
we got, you can draw once!"
choice_data_list:
One try alone isn't enough to expect 
results, huh?

I don't think we can expect much from just 
one try, can we?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! Races are always a one-shot 
deal too! This tension is what brings out 
my hidden strength.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Let's spin that raffle wheel with all our 
might, Trainer! Grab the handle and let's 
muscle!!
choice_data_list:
...Try not to break the lottery wheel, 
okay?

...Try not to break the lottery wheel, 
alright?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Aaah, you're right...!

After giving a brief reminder, the two of 
us grabbed the lever and took a shot at 
the raffle.
And the result is—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'm thinking... this is impossible... 
There's no way something like this could 
happen...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I tried to psych myself up and brush it 
off, but honestly, my bad luck is 
practically guaranteed...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"I'm the grand prize winner......... huh? 
Whaaat...?!"

It was such sheer good fortune that it 
hardly felt real to her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
A hot springs... ticket...! Awawawa, what 
should we do?!
choice_data_list:
Mejiro Ryan says you can use it however 
you want!

Mejiro Ryan says you can use it however 
you like!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? But I wouldn't even know how to 
handle something like that. Uuuu...
choice_data_list:
Why don't you go take a break with 
someone?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"There's no way someone like me has earned 
the right to rest!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
We're still only halfway along the path, 
and besides...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
McQueen's the one I want to talk to the 
most, but we're totally at each other's 
throats right now, and you're inviting her 
to a hot spring—?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I don't think you should do that. Because 
I don't think it would be good for either 
of you.

"Before the stubborn Mejiro Ryan, the hot 
spring trip ticket felt awkwardly out of 
place."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Um... could you hold onto those tickets 
for me, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I can't even think of a use for 
it. But that's...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"I think it's probably because I'm not 
qualified to use it yet."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
When the time comes, I'm sure I'll think 
of something. I'll do my best to come up 
with something. So please!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Please! Until someday, when I can finally 
enjoy free time and hobbies with genuine 
confidence!

Mejiro Ryan looks up at the sky. Let's 
save this hot spring voucher until she 
achieves a major feat.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
First prize!? Yay! I won something 
amazing!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Special Deluxe Carrot Hamburg Steak"! It 
feels just like ultra-premium whey 
protein!

...I don't quite get the comparison, but 
it sounds pretty high-end.
choice_data_list:
Still, a hamburg steak is a hamburg steak, 
I guess.

Still, a hamburg steak is a hamburg steak, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Trainer! That's not true at all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Come, look at this! The Hamburg steak 
sitting on the prize stand!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Lean meat with low fat is a show of 
confidence that it can win you over purely 
on its rich flavor.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
And carrots stabbed right in! This vivid 
crimson is proof of their high nutritional 
value!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"To use such top-grade ingredients so 
lavishly in a hamburger steak... I 
wouldn't have that kind of courage."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Still, whoever made this really nailed it! 
Thanks to them, I get to enjoy the 
ultimate healthy power food!

It seemed to be something of immense value 
to Mejiro Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, we're off to a great start this 
year. Let's eat a hearty meal and do our 
best!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yes! A whole heaping portion, you say?! 
That's still a fantastic result, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It's the stuff in that cardboard box over 
there, right? Whoa, it really is piled 
sky-high!
choice_data_list: Will we be able to take it home?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! I'm totally used to 
carrying cardboard boxes when buying in 
bulk.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
If it's just this much, it's not even a 
challenge— I could easily carry one more!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Mister lottery guy, can I take the one 
next to it too?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: "No can do~. We only won one case~."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that's right! I'm sorry, I'm sorry, 
I'm sorry!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
This isn't a strongman contest, after all. 
Heheh...

Even one case is plenty. After that, 
Mejiro Ryan and I enjoyed the carrots 
together.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
A carrot! And just one single piece!? 
Uuuu~...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Well, I kinda figured it'd turn out like 
this. It's not like pulling with all your 
might guarantees you'll get anything good 
anyway."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Right. Even if it's just a single strand, 
we can't afford to be careless.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Maybe carrots only turned this bright red 
because they worked out super hard and 
gave it their all, too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
When I think about it like that... it's 
kind of... hard to eat. Sorry, carrot...

I feel sympathy for the carrot. But I will 
enjoy it and let it become nourishment for 
tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... Pocket tissues, huh... This is... 
such a cruel result...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of tissues, there's something 
I've always thought about...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
McQueen always carries around both a clean 
handkerchief and tissues at all times.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Still, I couldn't help thinking "a single 
sports towel should be enough," and...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe this is a sign that I should 
reconsider my way of thinking. *Sigh*..."

"It's all a matter of perspective, but 
even so, tissues are still just tissues... 
I really wish I'd pulled something 
better."
